name: Izena (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Izena village emblem in red: a ring crossed by stylised characters of angular strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Izena, a village in Okinawa Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field.

features.role: Izena village emblem — a ring crossed by stylised characters of angular strokes
